First path can refuse parent/nested requests, avoiding parent-accounting expansion.

material_planning_points.point: Use N025 bindingRevision for R1/R2 policy identity, not policy.localPolicyRevision. Sampler/worker inventory deliberately retains the human revision. Translation must bind exact canonical policy plus SQL generation/readback, never attach a new generation to a cached sample.

N026 observed selected inputs and N023 observed lease do not imply ownership held. The local contract must explicitly choose cooperative snapshot semantics or enforce isolation; a numeric attempt fence cannot be derived from Git tip or claimed to fence external writers.

Pass the same bytes into bundle and dispatch. Required path refuses missing prepared bytes; legacy behavior stays separate.

Long-key derivation uses only six digest hex characters; a unique Fabric UUID is not proof of unique external r-* identity. Compare actual derived ID against trusted existing mappings or use an explicitly injective allowed short-key allocation with durable collision/reuse refusal. This is local mapping correctness, not a requested foreign protocol rewrite.

ready_next_module.name: Coherent bounded resource accounting read for one explicit host/pool
ready_next_module.contract: Separate dedicated service-only read; do not silently change the existing exact-eight-field publisher RPC. Read policy/generation/observation and root-held reservation sums from one coherent SQL snapshot; all resource dimensions belong to that same snapshot. Bind host/pool and full digest revision, bound numeric conversion, unknown stays unknown. Atomic SQL admission still rechecks under its lock, so advisory read is not capacity allocation. No raw table-read bypass or checker waiver. Initial no-parent path avoids unrelated hierarchical reader work.
ready_next_module.positive_negative: Actual isolated SQL coherent sums, root/child non-double-charge, empty ledger proven zero, foreign pool, malformed/overflow/stale observation and policy-generation change. No DB run requested in this review.

existing_ADR_no_new_domain: Coherent reserved/observed read and conservative zero overlap credit follow ADR0152 decisions1-3.
N025 digest-versus-human revision translation is existing policy identity enforcement, not a new policy decision.
Bind and transport the exact same prepared context/instruction bytes; use actual SQL run receipt, preserve begin/guard/compensation and unknown state under decisions3-4.
Build evidence-only assignment mapping and a bounded explicit-pool inventory without declaring held or enabling a path.
local_semantic_decision_required_before_: ADR0152 does not define a cooperative Git lease as exclusive file ownership. Selecting cooperative snapshot guarantees versus enforceable isolation needs an explicit Fabric-owned design/ADR before translating N023/N026 into R1 held. This is not an operator gate or COM prerequisite by itself.
Define internal attempt fence ownership/allocation/restart semantics and pool membership boundary. Existing Git tip/app invocation ID/SQL run ordinal must not be silently conflated into that fence.
actual_cross_owner_only: Changing agent-sync lease authority or publishing portable reservation/ownership/event semantics requires its owning project. Pure local readers, SQL snapshots, byte binding and fixture composition do not.
